name: doobie
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：doobie。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Browser automation with persistent named pages via the doobie CLI. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, log into sites, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", "open the browser", or any browser
unshelve_reason: 问一 · 1.5KB 正文里方法全推给 `doobie --help`，自己只留了几条分号和 ref 失效的 gotcha，用户拿到正文本身得不到任何可迁移的判断。同一作者的 dev-browser 已按同一条判过（正文二十行、唯一方法是 --help）；一个人不该拿同一个壳占两个位。 正文原话：Run `doobie --help` (full guide; `doobie help <topic>` for one section) before non-trivial work.
